cues.en: Now.

So I've just put the Floyd-warshall algorithm over here.
So we need to write the fourth step like this.
So in the fourth step we are going to check for the negative cycles.
And we are going to include the negative cycle vertices over here.

Then we are going to loop through the vertices array starting from the first vertex which is located

Now, in the next city we have Paris.
